briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Tax Fight Gets Political Cover as Psychedelic Medicine Hits the Mainstream
briefs.top: Michigan operators are watching a governor's race turn into a referendum on the 24% wholesale tax while the state's cumulative cannabis sales blow past $17 billion — proof the market is still growing even under pressure. Nationally, the FDA's landmark psychedelics hearing and Compass Pathways' march toward an NDA filing show federal momentum accelerating for both cannabis and psychedelic medicine.
